verdict.rationale: Khoj's core function is AI chat grounded in the user's own files. The docs show it answers from shared notes and documents, cites the reference notes behind each response, and can run Python to analyze data and generate plots and reports. It also offers related-note discovery and scheduled research automations. Community reports note that small local models struggle with personal-notes context, which tempers confidence in insight quality. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that insights from user data are good, and documented proactive suggestions beyond similar-note discovery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can chat with it about anything. It'll use files you shared with it to respond, when relevant.
This is useful if you want to have Khoj do some data analysis, generate plots and reports.
Shows reference notes used to generate a response
Discover: Find similar notes to the current one
